Joint budget · 300 listed field hours / 30-day reap

scope: Explicit partial cereal field-task allocation, not total subsistence labour, historical household composition or observed harvest calendars. The 40% worker share and work windows are sensitivities. Listed reaping hours are a subset of listed annual work. Draft services and other tasks remain omitted. Rural food needs remain fixed at the earlier baseline instead of falling when production is curtailed. The same resulting grain flows constrain residents and available institutional reach sources.
